senses.sense_definition: A member of a race of one-eyed giants in Greek and Roman mythology.

examples.text: Odysseus used his clever wit to escape from the cave of the angry <w>cyclops</w>.
In ancient legends, the <w>cyclops</w> forged powerful lightning bolts for the king of the gods.

senses.sense_definition: Any creature, monster, or animal that has only one eye.

examples.text: The science fiction movie featured an alien <w>cyclops</w> roaming the barren planet.
The lamb was born as a <w>cyclops</w> due to a rare genetic defect affecting head development.

senses.sense_definition: A person who has only one functional eye.

examples.text: After losing his sight in an accident, he jokingly called himself a <w>cyclops</w>.
Wearing a dark eyepatch, the wounded soldier felt like a <w>cyclops</w> among his peers.

senses.sense_definition: A tiny freshwater copepod belonging to the genus Cyclops, characterized by a single central eye spot.

examples.text: Under the microscope, the student observed a swimming <w>cyclops</w> in the pond water sample.
A tiny <w>cyclops</w> serves as an important food source for small fish in freshwater lakes.

senses.sense_definition: A small magnifying lens mounted on the crystal of a watch to make the date window easier to read.

examples.text: The vintage luxury watch features a built-in <w>cyclops</w> that magnifies the date display.
He scratched the <w>cyclops</w> on his watch crystal against the rough metal railing.
